qaOrderLogic: Favour already canonical-and-approved source artwork IDs, prior visual proof and official collection photo sources; reserve all four B13 accepted-source remediation cases; pilot is a queue not release order. safety: No old work approval automatically carries over from another photo, no image submitted without confirmed exact licensing and native visual review; crop/frame removal is evaluated on exact object pixels.
